ffmpeg_required:
Tsarin `{{module_name}}` yana buƙatar **FFmpeg** don aiki. Da fatan za a shigar da shi daga gidan yanar gizon hukuma: - [https://ffmpeg.org](https://ffmpeg.org)

Idan an riga an shigar da FFmpeg, buɗe sabon tashar umarni, gwada `ffmpeg -version`, sannan ka sake kunna HomeGenie daga wannan tashar. Idan ba kwa buƙatar wannan fasalin, kuna iya kashe wannan ɓangaren a cikin sashin Shirye-shiryen Atomatik na **, ko ta danna maɓallin da ke ƙasa.
